messages.subject: Fwd: transitions
parts:
Hi all.  See below.  This is for our ONR grant on informative priors, but I think we can include just about anything Stan-related.  Can you plz help with some examples?  If we can give them 50 examples of Stan being used, that would be great!  (ONR is funding us in various ways so we'd like to be helpful to them.)
Thx
A


Begin forwarded message:

From: "Neskovic, Predrag CIV ONR, 31" <predrag....@navy.mil>
Subject: transitions
Date: August 26, 2016 at 1:31:54 PM EDT
To: "Neskovic, Predrag CIV ONR, 31" <predrag....@navy.mil>
Cc: "pedja.n...@gmail.com" <pedja.n...@gmail.com>

Dear PIs,

It's that time of the year again to collect transitions. If you had transitions over the last year, please fill out the attached form and send it back to me. If you are not sure what qualifies as “transition" please feel free to contact me. For example, if there is a company or an agency (e.g. NGA) that is using some of your results (e.g. software or an algorithm) that you have developed, that would qualify as transition. The company/agency does not have to pay you for the use of that software/algorithm.  

Demonstrating impact of this program is extremely important for the continuation of the program. Your help is therefore highly appreciated.  

Please provide your inputs by September 10.  

Thanks,

Pedja

Arlington, VA 22203

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Fwd: transitions
parts:
Here's more than a dozen public citations using Stan with authors
affiliated with companies. I found these on Google using
search ["mc-stan.org" pharamcology pk/pd]

Novartis (Switzerland)
* http://www.page-meeting.org/?abstract=3200

Novartis (New Jersey)
* http://andrewgelman.com/2015/10/05/pmxstan-an-r-package-to-facilitate-bayesian-pkpd-modeling-with-stan/

Quantitative Solutions, LP (California)
* http://www.page-meeting.org/?abstract=3605

Division of Clinical Pharmacology, Children’s National Medical Center (Washington, DC)
* http://www.page-meeting.org/?abstract=3605

Sanofi (Massachussetts)
* http://www.page-meeting.org/?abstract=5972
* http://www.page-meeting.org/pdf_assets/9034-PAGE_2016_SD_Final.pdf

Merck (Switzerland)
* http://www.page-meeting.org/pdf_assets/10000-SwatTerranova_PharmML_SO_poster_PAGE2016.pdf

Assistance Publique Hopitaux de Paris (France)
* http://www.page-meeting.org/pdf_assets/3337-JB_PAGE_2015_alternative.pdf

ICON (California) [if you count the ideas as well as the software]
* http://www.page-meeting.org/pdf_assets/473-nonmem_pdxpop_poster_board5.pdf

Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute (Switzerland)
* http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4335872/

Public Health Research Institute Center (New Jersey)
* http://europepmc.org/articles/PMC4335872

Liaison Psychiatry Service, Cambridge and Peterborough NHS Foundation Trust (UK)
* http://www.jneurosci.org/content/34/22/7663.full

Wolfson Brain Imaging Centre, Addenbrooke's Hospital (UK)
* http://www.jneurosci.org/content/34/22/7663.full

Hinrichsen Environmental Services (Washington)
* http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/00028487.2013.788553

Bonneville Power Administration (Oregon)
* http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/00028487.2013.788553


The following is fisheries, which may also be of interest to
ONR---it's a dynamics model if not one based on diff eqs:

Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (Germany)
* http://www.cell.com/trends/ecology-evolution/pdf/S0169-5347(15)00240-2.pdf

- Bob
